name: securitylake
description: Amazon Security Lake is a fully managed security data lake service.

subcommands.name: create-aws-log-source
subcommands.description: Adds a natively supported Amazon Web Services service as an Amazon Security Lake source.

subcommands.name: create-custom-log-source
subcommands.description: Adds a third-party custom source in Amazon Security Lake, from the Amazon Web Services Region where you want to create a custom source.

subcommands.name: create-data-lake
subcommands.description: Initializes an Amazon Security Lake instance with the provided (or default) configuration.

subcommands.name: create-data-lake-exception-subscription
subcommands.description: Creates the specified notification subscription in Amazon Security Lake for the organization you specify.

subcommands.name: create-data-lake-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Automatically enables Amazon Security Lake for new member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: create-subscriber
subcommands.description: Creates a subscriber for accounts that are already enabled in Amazon Security Lake.

subcommands.name: create-subscriber-notification
subcommands.description: Notifies the subscriber when new data is written to the data lake for the sources that the subscriber consumes in Security Lake.

subcommands.name: delete-aws-log-source
subcommands.description: Removes a natively supported Amazon Web Services service as an Amazon Security Lake source.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-log-source
subcommands.description: Removes a custom log source from Amazon Security Lake, to stop sending data from the custom source to Security Lake.

subcommands.name: delete-data-lake
subcommands.description: When you disable Amazon Security Lake from your account, Security Lake is disabled in all Amazon Web Services Regions and it stops collecting data from your sources.

subcommands.name: delete-data-lake-exception-subscription
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified notification subscription in Amazon Security Lake for the organization you specify.

subcommands.name: delete-data-lake-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Turns off automatic enablement of Amazon Security Lake for member accounts that are added to an organization in Organizations.

subcommands.name: delete-subscriber
subcommands.description: Deletes the subscription permission and all notification settings for accounts that are already enabled in Amazon Security Lake.

subcommands.name: delete-subscriber-notification
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified subscription notification in Amazon Security Lake for the organization you specify.

subcommands.name: deregister-data-lake-delegated-administrator
subcommands.description: Deletes the Amazon Security Lake delegated administrator account for the organization.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-exception-subscription
subcommands.description: Retrieves the protocol and endpoint that were provided when subscribing to Amazon SNS topics for exception notifications.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-organization-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration that will be automatically set up for accounts added to the organization after the organization has onboarded to Amazon Security Lake.

subcommands.name: get-data-lake-sources
subcommands.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the current Region, including whether Amazon Security Lake is enabled for those accounts and which sources Security Lake is collecting data from.

subcommands.name: get-subscriber
subcommands.description: Retrieves the subscription information for the specified subscription ID.

subcommands.name: list-data-lake-exceptions
subcommands.description: Lists the Amazon Security Lake exceptions that you can use to find the source of problems and fix them.

subcommands.name: list-data-lakes
subcommands.description: Retrieves the Amazon Security Lake configuration object for the specified Amazon Web Services Regions.

subcommands.name: list-log-sources
subcommands.description: Retrieves the log sources.

subcommands.name: list-subscribers
subcommands.description: Lists all subscribers for the specific Amazon Security Lake account ID.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Retrieves the tags (keys and values) that are associated with an Amazon Security Lake resource: a subscriber, or the data lake configuration for your Amazon Web Services account in a particular Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: register-data-lake-delegated-administrator
subcommands.description: Designates the Amazon Security Lake delegated administrator account for the organization.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates one or more tags that are associated with an Amazon Security Lake resource: a subscriber, or the data lake configuration for your Amazon Web Services account in a particular Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes one or more tags (keys and values) from an Amazon Security Lake resource: a subscriber, or the data lake configuration for your Amazon Web Services account in a particular Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: update-data-lake
subcommands.description: You can use UpdateDataLake to specify where to store your security data, how it should be encrypted at rest and for how long.

subcommands.name: update-data-lake-exception-subscription
subcommands.description: Updates the specified notification subscription in Amazon Security Lake for the organization you specify.

subcommands.name: update-subscriber
subcommands.description: Updates an existing subscription for the given Amazon Security Lake account ID.

subcommands.name: update-subscriber-notification
subcommands.description: Updates an existing notification method for the subscription (SQS or HTTPs endpoint) or switches the notification subscription endpoint for a subscriber.
